vendors.pricing_starting: Free tier available (Explorer, 3 seats); paid plans from $4,800/yr
vendors.pricing_notes: Four tiers: Free/Explorer ($0, up to 3 Full Access seats), Connector ($4,800/yr, 1 seat included; additional Full Access seats $1,800/user/yr), Supernode (custom), and Enterprise (custom). All plans include annual Crossbeam Credits for AI/MCP access: Free 50, Connector 500, Supernode 2,500, Enterprise 5,000. Supernode and Enterprise can buy extra credit packs: 10,000 for $1,000, 25,000 for $2,500, or 100,000 for $9,000 (10% discount); credits are pooled and reset annually. MCP credit metering began September 1, 2026. Crossbeam Sales Edge (formerly Partnered) is an add-on. Sources: https://www.crossbeam.com/pricing, https://help.crossbeam.com/en/articles/12601327-crossbeam-mcp-server, https://help.crossbeam.com/en/articles/15588582-crossbeam-credits-faq
